meta.source: Kenshi base game (data/gui/colours/kenshi_colours.xml, data/gui/fonts/kenshi_fonts.xml, data/gui/skins/kenshi_skins.xml, data/gui/gfx/Kenshi_UI.png) and the Meitou main menu sketch (floating plates, variant A).

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: The dark falloff behind floating UI: radial-gradient from rgba(8, 6, 5, .93) to transparent. Also the page ground for previews.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Average of a window plate (rust texture under plate-tint). Fallback fill and chart backgrounds.

tokens.name: plate-tint
tokens.usage: Layer over the rust texture that makes a plate: barely-there rust, mostly dark.

tokens.name: plate-rim
tokens.usage: 1px inner rim on plates and hairlines between sections on a plate.

tokens.name: metal-edge
tokens.usage: Worn outer edge of the game's buttons; bar tracks and slot outlines.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Average of the worn paper (GenericTextBoxSkin). Fallback fill behind the paper texture.

tokens.name: paper-light
tokens.usage: Bleached paper. Hover and selected text on plates; key badges' text.

tokens.name: paper-edge
tokens.usage: The 2px dark border drawn inside every paper card (the Continue card's edge).

tokens.name: paper-wear
tokens.usage: Soft 10px darkening inside the paper edge.

tokens.name: main
tokens.usage: Game colour Main. All text on plates, buttons and tabs.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Game colour Secondary. Text on paper. 3.9:1 on paper, the game's own pairing: keep it at 16px semibold or larger, 12px only for secondary metadata.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Game colour Title. Headings on paper-light only (fails on paper).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Game colour Bad. Negative values on paper-light.

tokens.name: bad-bright
tokens.usage: Game colour BadBright. Penalties, the Exit hover and danger text on plates. Pair with a minus sign or a verb.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Game colour Good. Bonuses on plates.

tokens.name: greyed
tokens.usage: Game colour Greyed. Disabled plates.

tokens.name: greyed-bright
tokens.usage: Game colour GreyedBright. Disabled text and unselected tabs on plates.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Active speed-button glyphs; the selected tab's underline.

tokens.name: brass-light
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, offset 2px) and the selected portrait ring.

tokens.name: dialogue-option
tokens.usage: Game colour DialogueTextOption. Reply options on plates.

tokens.name: dialogue-hover
tokens.usage: Game colour DialogueTextOptionHover. The hovered reply.

tokens.name: dialogue-bubble
tokens.usage: Game colour DialogueBubbleText. Spoken lines on plates.

tokens.name: item-standard
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemStandard. Names of standard items.

tokens.name: grade-0
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemGrade0 (Prototype, Rusted Junk). 20px+ only on plates (3.3:1).

tokens.name: grade-1
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemGrade1.

tokens.name: grade-2
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemGrade2.

tokens.name: grade-3
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemGrade3.

tokens.name: grade-4
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemGrade4 (Masterwork, Meitou).

tokens.name: artifact
tokens.usage: Game colour ItemArtifact.

tokens.name: bar-life
tokens.usage: Average of the health fill texture (LifeBarSkin).

tokens.name: bar-healed
tokens.usage: Average of the bandaged fill (LifeBarHealedSkin). Also hunger.

tokens.name: bar-stunned
tokens.usage: Average of the stun fill (LifeBarStunnedSkin).

tokens.name: bar-hurt
tokens.usage: Average of the below-zero fill (LifeBarHurtSkin).

tokens.name: bar-robot
tokens.usage: Average of the robotic limb fill (LifeBarRobotSkin).

tokens.name: marker-ally
tokens.usage: Game colour MarkerAlly.

tokens.name: marker-neutral
tokens.usage: Game colour MarkerNeutral.

tokens.name: marker-enemy
tokens.usage: Game colour MarkerEnemy.

tokens.name: marker-player
tokens.usage: Game colour MarkerPlayer.

styles.name: menu-primary
styles.usage: The primary action on a paper card, uppercase.

styles.name: standard-medium
styles.usage: Kenshi_StandardFont_Medium. Card headings, item names, speakers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Save details and other metadata under a primary label.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Key badges, uppercase, on a dark chip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between tabs in a tab strip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to bar; extra gap before a destructive item.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked plate buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Below the primary card in a stack; small gaps in rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), icon to label, between cards in a window.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and window padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between floating windows.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: One inventory slot.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Health and experience bars, inventory items.

tokens.name: radius-portrait
tokens.usage: Portraits and key badges.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Plate buttons and tabs (soft corners, variant A).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Paper cards, windows and tooltips.

tokens.name: plate-drop
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the world: windows, the primary card, tooltips.

tokens.name: paper-border
tokens.usage: The paper card's edge: 2px dark line, 1px faint inner line, soft wear.

tokens.name: plate-border
tokens.usage: The plate's faint inner rim.
